units.source_text: "足利义满①承受了西园寺②家的北山殿，并在那里建筑了一幢规模宏大的别墅。

en.t: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu inherited the Kitayama Palace of the Saionji family, and there built a large-scale villa.

units.source_text: 主要建筑物有舍利殿、护摩堂、仔法堂、法水院等佛教建筑群，

en.t: The main buildings included a group of Buddhist structures such as the Shariden, the Gomado, the Shihodo, and the Hosui-in,

units.source_text: 还有表殿、公卿间、会堂、天镜阁、拱北楼、泉殿、现雪亭等住宅建筑群。

en.t: as well as a group of residential buildings such as the Omote-den, the Kugyo-no-ma, the meeting hall, the Tenkyo-kaku, the Kyohoku-ro, the Izumi-dono, and the Gensetsu-tei.

units.source_text: 舍利殿的建筑耗资巨大，这就是后来称做金阁的建筑物。

en.t: The construction of the Shariden required enormous expense, and this was the building later called the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 究竟什么时候开始叫做金阁，是很难划分清楚的。

en.t: It is difficult to determine clearly exactly when it began to be called the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 一般地说，是应仁之乱①以后，文明年间已经普遍沿用这一名称了。

en.t: Generally speaking, after the Onin War, by the Bunmei era this name was already in common use.
